Welcome to the Department of the County Assessor
Bob Boyer was elected the first Republican Assessor of Jefferson County since 1931. He took office on September 1st, 2017, and was re-elected in November, 2020. Mr. Boyer is a Missouri State Licensed Real Estate Appraiser, President of the Central East Missouri Assessors' Association, and Education Coordinator for the Missouri State Assessors' Association. Mr. Boyer is a lifelong resident of Jefferson County, graduating from Festus High School and Jefferson College. Prior to becoming Assessor, Mr. Boyer was a licensed professional land surveyor and spent 15 years practicing surveying in Missouri, Illinois, and Arkansas. He is active in the Boy Scouts of America, serving on his local troop committee and as a Cub Scouts den leader.
The Assessor's website is intended to answer questions about property tax assessment and provide access to available services. The left side menu includes links to information on real estate, personal property, and on-line forms. Below are links to the Assessor's GIS (Geographic Information System) data and maps.
Please do not hesitate to contact our office with any questions. We are here to serve.
Sincerely,
Bob Boyer
Jefferson County Assessor
